why.eyebrow.description: Why FinDera section — small label above the heading.
why.title: Dependable quality in knowledge and contacts.
why.lead: Long experience means I recognise the solutions that work and can pick the sites that genuinely benefit you — while making sure the encounters are well run and worth the time. Progress stays controlled, purposeful and productive.
why.1.title: Precise scoping and targeting
why.1.desc: I define the criteria together with you and quickly identify the most relevant solutions, sites and players.
why.1.desc.description: Why FinDera section, item 1 — body text.
why.2.title: Relationships with the right people
why.2.desc: I turn contacts into concrete encounters and make sure each discussion has a clear objective and structure.
why.2.desc.description: Why FinDera section, item 2 — body text.
why.3.title: Comparable practical understanding
why.3.desc: I distil what works in practice and under what conditions — to support your decision-making.
why.3.desc.description: Why FinDera section, item 3 — body text.
why.4.title: Impact and next steps
why.4.desc: I take the work towards the next stage: a draft decision, a pilot, a partnership path or a clear roadmap.
why.4.desc.description: Why FinDera section, item 4 — body text.
why.5.title: A rare perspective
why.5.desc: My multi-stakeholder background brings realism, an overall picture and the ability to combine the needs of different parties.
why.5.desc.description: Why FinDera section, item 5 — body text.
why.6.title: Track record and networks
why.6.desc: Over 70 trips delivered and some 1,300 participants, plus a broad working network across Europe, particularly in the DACH region — including market entries for Finnish companies.
why.6.desc.description: Why FinDera section, item 6 — body text.

quotes.title: What clients say
quotes.title.description: Client testimonials — heading. Shared across all pages — if you change this, change the same text in the other page files too.
quote.1.text: FinDera delivered the trip for our management team and board very smoothly on a turnkey basis. The trip provided valuable shared time, new perspectives and strengthened our common view of developing the company.
quote.2.text: Martin planned the trip largely on a turnkey basis while still taking our wishes into account. During the trip he was an invaluable guide, tour leader and interpreter, which made the whole thing successful and effortless.
quote.3.text: FinDera built an excellent package at board level: relevant sites, well-prepared meetings and smooth arrangements. We gained a valuable knowledge base to support investment decisions.
